article_blocks.text: Strain Type: Balanced Hybrid (Slightly Indica-Leaning)
Genetics: Biscotti × Jealousy × Sherb Bx
Breeder: Seed Junky Genetics x Doja Pak collab
THC Content: 24–30%
CBD Content: Low (typically under 1%)
Terpene Profile: Caryophyllene , Limonene , Myrcene
Primary Flavors: Sweet Candy, Gas, Floral, Creamy
Flowering Time (Indoor): 8–9 weeks
Outdoor Harvest Time: Early October
Indoor Yield: 16–20 oz per m²
Outdoor Yield: 18–22 oz per plant
Grow Difficulty: Moderate

Permanent Marker is one of the most talked-about modern cannabis cultivars to emerge from California’s contemporary breeding scene. Created by Seed Junky Genetics in collaboration with Doja Pak, the strain quickly gained recognition for its distinctive aroma and striking potency. Its name captures the experience perfectly: a sharp, pungent scent that lingers in the air much like the smell of a freshly opened marker.

What makes this hybrid especially intriguing is the combination of dessert-style sweetness and chemical sharpness that defines its terpene profile. Beneath the bold aroma lies a balanced yet powerful effect profile capable of delivering both euphoric mental uplift and deeply relaxing body sensations. As a result, the cultivar has become widely celebrated among cannabis enthusiasts seeking both flavor complexity and high potency.
Genetics and Lineage

The genetic structure of Permanent Marker reflects a carefully engineered blend of some of the most influential modern cannabis families. One parent, Biscotti, is known for its rich dessert-like aroma, dense trichome coverage, and calming hybrid effects. Derived from Gelato genetics, Biscotti contributes sweetness, creamy undertones, and strong resin production to the final cross.

Another major contributor is Jealousy, a highly regarded hybrid also developed by Seed Junky Genetics. Jealousy gained popularity for its balanced effects and visually striking buds covered in thick layers of trichomes. Within this cultivar, Jealousy enhances both potency and visual appeal while adding subtle fruit and citrus elements to the terpene profile.

The final component, Sherb Bx (a Sherbet backcross), introduces additional layers of sweetness and aromatic depth. Sherbet genetics are widely recognized for their creamy, candy-like flavors and relaxing hybrid effects. When combined with Biscotti and Jealousy, the Sherb lineage rounds out the terpene complexity and reinforces the strain’s balanced but powerful effect profile.

Through selective breeding and phenotype hunting, Seed Junky Genetics refined the hybrid into a cultivar with strong terpene intensity, impressive THC levels , and distinctive aromatic traits. This careful selection process helped produce a strain capable of standing out even in an era dominated by complex dessert-style cannabis hybrids.
Effects and Experience

The experience produced by this hybrid often begins with a noticeable shift in mood. Shortly after consumption, a gentle cerebral lift tends to emerge, bringing heightened sensory awareness and a mild wave of euphoria. Thoughts may become more fluid, and everyday surroundings can feel slightly more vibrant and engaging.

As the experience progresses, the strain’s physical effects begin to reveal themselves. A warm sensation spreads through the body, gradually relaxing muscles and reducing physical tension. Unlike heavy sedative strains , however, the relaxation tends to arrive without immediately overwhelming the mind. This balance allows the cultivar to provide comfort while maintaining a sense of mental clarity.

With larger doses, the later stages of the experience can become deeply calming. The body settles into a tranquil state while the mind drifts toward introspection or quiet contentment. For many consumers, the strain works particularly well in the evening when relaxation and mood elevation are the primary goals.
Medical Benefits

The strong cannabinoid and terpene profile associated with this cultivar may provide a range of therapeutic benefits. Its relaxing body effects make it a potential option for individuals dealing with chronic muscle tension or persistent physical discomfort. High THC levels may contribute to analgesic properties that help reduce the perception of pain.

Stress reduction is another commonly discussed benefit. The uplifting mental effects can temporarily ease mental fatigue or emotional tension, helping the mind transition into a calmer state. Many medical marijuana users find the strain particularly useful when attempting to decompress after demanding days.

Additionally, the relaxing qualities of the plant may support sleep preparation. As the effects deepen, the body’s sense of relaxation may encourage restful sleep, especially when consumed during evening hours. While the strain can promote calmness, dosage often plays an important role in balancing relaxation with mental clarity.
Flavor Profile and Aroma

The aroma of Permanent Marker is one of its most defining features. When the flower is first handled, a bold chemical-like scent immediately becomes noticeable. This sharp aroma resembles the smell of ink or fresh marker solvent, which inspired the cultivar’s distinctive name.

Beneath this pungent top note lies a layered terpene profile that introduces sweetness and subtle fruitiness. Limonene contributes citrus brightness, while caryophyllene adds a peppery warmth that enhances the complexity of the aroma. Linalool brings a faint floral softness that helps balance the sharper chemical tones.

During consumption, the flavor profile reveals additional nuance. The inhale often carries sweet candy-like notes mixed with herbal spice. As the vapor or smoke lingers on the palate, earthy undertones and subtle chemical hints appear, creating a flavor progression that feels both bold and unexpectedly refined.
Growing Information

Cultivators working with this hybrid typically encounter a plant with strong structural stability and vigorous growth. The plant develops a medium height with sturdy branches capable of supporting dense flower clusters. This structure makes the strain suitable for training techniques such as topping or low-stress training to improve canopy distribution.

Indoor flowering cycles usually complete within eight to nine weeks. During this stage, the plant produces dense buds heavily coated in trichomes. The flowers often display vibrant shades of green with occasional purple hues and bright orange pistils, creating a visually striking appearance.

Outdoor growers may achieve excellent results in climates with consistent sunlight and moderate humidity. With sufficient space and airflow, the plant can produce generous yields of aromatic, resin-rich buds. Because the terpene profile is particularly strong, proper ventilation and odor management are often important considerations during cultivation .
FAQ
What kind of strain is Permanent Marker? Permanent Marker is a balanced hybrid created by crossing Biscotti, Jealousy, and Sherb Bx.
How strong is Permanent Marker? THC levels typically range between 25% and 30%, making it one of the more potent modern cannabis strains.
Why is the strain called Permanent Marker? The name refers to its distinctive aroma, which resembles the sharp chemical scent of a permanent marker combined with sweet dessert-like notes.
Is Permanent Marker good for nighttime use? Many consumers prefer it during the evening because its relaxing body effects can promote calmness and stress relief.
Is Permanent Marker easy to grow? The strain is generally considered moderately easy to cultivate, producing dense, resinous buds when grown under stable environmental conditions.
Final Thoughts on Permanent Marker

Permanent Marker represents the evolving direction of modern cannabis breeding, where terpene complexity and visual appeal stand alongside potency as defining traits. By combining Biscotti, Jealousy, and Sherb genetics, Seed Junky Genetics created a hybrid that delivers both remarkable flavor and powerful effects.

The strain’s unusual aroma sets it apart from many contemporary cultivars. Its blend of chemical sharpness, candy-like sweetness, and earthy spice creates an aromatic profile that is instantly recognizable. For cannabis enthusiasts who appreciate bold terpene expression, the experience can be particularly memorable.

Beyond its sensory appeal, the cultivar also provides a balanced effect profile capable of delivering mental uplift alongside physical relaxation. This combination has helped it earn a strong reputation among both recreational consumers and those exploring cannabis for stress relief and relaxation. As modern breeding continues to evolve, Permanent Marker stands as an example of how careful genetic selection can produce cultivars that push the boundaries of aroma, potency, and overall cannabis experience.
